spec_coverage.notes: All assigned requirements verified in the worktree at HEAD 9ed954142. Precedence order in JobCriteriaSection.tsx:43-82 matches SPEC §8.2 exactly: isLoading early return (43) → isError early return (51, conventions item 4: 'Could not load job criteria' / 'Something went wrong while loading job criteria. Refresh the page to try again.', alert-triangle, no action row) → isPayloadStatusInFlight → failed+zeroCriteriaFailure → failed → criteria present → else never-extracted. All EmptyState copy strings byte-match the spec (titles, messages, icons); all four EmptyStates are standard variant (only icon/title/message passed; EmptyState.tsx props verified). Action rows are section-level (Styled.ActionRow, line 144) outside EmptyState. Button label rule verified: regenerateButtonLabel keys off displayState === 'neverExtracted', which the in-flight branch resolves to when criteria is absent (state 1 over 5 → 'Generate criteria'). isInFlight = isPayloadStatusInFlight || isFetching traces to plan D-5 with the broader-than-post-POST cost documented in plan R-3 (accepted). loading AND disabled both present (lines 159-160). Intro copy byte-matches after JSX whitespace collapse; link uses history.push('/jobs/${job.id}/setup/description') threaded from props.history (JobSetupContainer.tsx:487 spreads route props; OrganizationAiUsage.tsx:18 pattern). Card: 560px, ${t.rounded.md} (conventions item 5), PlatoChip size 36 radius 18, 15px/600 title, 12.5px/1.3 desc with tabular-nums, distanceInWords adds 'ago' (time.ts:89). Count rail 186px, .n uses ${t.text.medium} (conventions item 7), Bonus row skipped when tier_3 count is 0 (line 104). jobCriteriaTiers.ts matches conventions item 3 (key/label/icon/glossaryLead/glossaryRest), consumed by all three components; copy strings byte-match plan F.2.2.2 and DECISIONS leads. Sidebar matches the AccountTeam register (Styled.Sidebar/TierContent parallel AccountTeam.tsx:515-552 with the conventions-item-6 token substitutions t.text.base/t.text.sm and the planned 13px icon wrapper CSS). Focus ring on SectionIntro a present (conventions item 8). JobSetupAiSettings.tsx diff is additions-only (no pre-existing line modified or deleted): imports, SidebarContent, sidebar prop, JobCriteriaSection mount below the Plato reviews FormSection, appended styled block. poly.color tokens (cardCanvas/cardBorder/loudText/secondaryText) exist in shared/styles/lightTheme.ts and are an established usage pattern (FormSection, NavItem, JobApplicationSidebar). Two observations, judged not findings: (1) The View criteria button renders whenever displayState resolves to 'card', which includes SPEC §8.2 row 1 in-flight over an older success; §8.3 says View is 'rendered only in state 4' while row 1 says the underlying content is 'row 4's card'. I read the implementation as correct because §8.4's frozen-prop staleness note ('if a regeneration completes while the slide-over is open') presupposes the slide-over is reachable while an extraction is in flight; flagging here as a note in case the spec author intended View hidden during in-flight. (2) The intro's <a> has onClick but no href/tabIndex, so the conventions-item-8 focus ring is unreachable by keyboard; the adjudicated fix text (add the &:focus CSS) is implemented literally and no spec text requires focusability, so this is recorded as an observation only.
